QuestInfo.name: [Competitive Content] The 2nd Monster Carnival
QuestInfo.2:
Marvel at the 2nd Monster Carnival, a festival for true fighters! The team that earns more CP in 10 minutes by defeating monsters will win the match. There are more opportunities for wily fighters to beat stronger parties this time, by using the skills, monsters, and protectors obtainable at the cost of CP.



- #eTime Limit#n : 10 min

- #eRoute#n: Dimensional Mirrors in each town

- #eBattleground#n 
 
1) Field 1: 2 - 4 players, Easy 
 
2) Field 2: 2 - 4 players, Normal
 
3) Field 3: 3 - 6 players, Hard 

- #eFinal Reward#n : #b#i1122058# #t1122058##k
 (Obtain at least 150 #t04001254#s 
 to receive the reward from #p2042000#)
